newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Oct core inflation drops to 8.0 pct -banker.
newsitem.headline: Greek Oct core inflation drops to 8.0 pct -banker.

text.p: Greece's core CPI inflation, which does not include volatile food and energy prices, fell to 8.0 percent year-on-year in October from 8.2 percent in September, an economist at a foreign bank told Reuters.
Headline inflation eased to 8.3 percent year-on-year in October from 8.5 percent in September.
The National Statistics Service does not release core inflation figures. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
